name: Inventory Report - Profit
query:
SELECT
    -- Info Item
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', sii.item_code, sii.item_name, i.brand) AS "Item Info:Data:300",
    
    -- Kolom Penjualan
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 0, sii.qty, 0)) AS "Qty Sale:Float:120",
    -- Hapus referensi /ccy agar menggunakan default currency sistem (Base)
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 0, sii.base_net_amount, 0)) AS "Sale Amount:Currency:150",
    
    -- HPP
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 0, (sii.qty * sii.incoming_rate), 0)) AS "Cost Amount:Currency:150",
    
    -- Kolom Retur
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 1, sii.qty, 0)) AS "Qty Retur:Float:120",
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 1, sii.base_net_amount, 0)) AS "Return Amount:Currency:150",
    SUM(IF(si.is_return = 1, (sii.qty * sii.incoming_rate), 0)) AS "Cost Retur Amt:Currency:150",
    
    -- Profit
    (SUM(sii.base_net_amount)) AS "Net Sales:Currency:150",
    (SUM(sii.base_net_amount) - SUM(sii.qty * sii.incoming_rate)) AS "Gross Profit:Currency:150",
    
    -- Persentase
    IF(
        SUM(sii.base_net_amount) = 0, 0,
        (
            (SUM(sii.base_net_amount) - SUM(sii.qty * sii.incoming_rate)) / SUM(sii.base_net_amount)
        ) * 100
    ) AS "Percent:Int:100"

FROM
    `tabSales Invoice Item` AS sii
JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice` AS si ON si.name = sii.parent
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` AS i ON i.name = sii.item_code
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
    sii.item_code
ORDER BY
    (SUM(sii.base_net_amount) - SUM(sii.qty * sii.incoming_rate)) DESC;
